items.body_excerpt: Khris Middleton was asked just now how AJ Dybantsa has looked. "He's been great," Middleton said. "He plays fast. He's aggressive, which I think we all like. ... I think he picks things up quickly, the terminology.  I think he's way ahead of a lot of rookies that I've seen come in."

items.title: I'm told the only players who did not participate in the Wizards' scrimmage today were Alex Sarr (who is set to ramp up to full contact in upcoming days), Tristan Vukčević (hip impingement) and Khris Middleton (ramping up/no injury).
